short: Guard models trained on AI-generated examples of a written policy's edges, used to catch jailbreak attempts a main model misses.
definition: Constitutional classifiers are input and output filters trained specifically to resist jailbreaks, using training examples generated by having a model follow a written "constitution" that spells out which content is allowed and which is not, including many disguised and translated variants of disallowed requests. Because the training data is synthetically generated rather than hand-labeled, the classifiers can be refreshed quickly as new jailbreak styles appear. Anthropic introduced the approach and reported that it sharply cut the success rate of large-scale jailbreak attempts against Claude in red-teaming trials, at the cost of a small increase in refusals and compute.
